Question: When updating vendor details as an individual with Singpass, what happens if the government database connectivity fails?
Answer:
If you are updating as an individual with Singpass and the connectivity to the government database fails, the vendor name field will be available for updating only when the connection is restored; otherwise, your name will be retrieved from MyInfo when the connectivity is restored and you can update your vendor details later. Question: What is the difference between how the Official Name and Vendor Name fields are populated for a local company?
Answer:
The Official Name field is populated from the government database (Enterprise Data Hub - EDH). It shows the exact registered/legal name and is not editable for local companies. In contrast, the Vendor Name field is populated from your official name (the first 80 characters) and is what is displayed as the vendor name; for local companies, this field can be edited to reflect a name different from the Official Name, up to the first 80 characters. Question: What must an unapproved vendor ensure before their record can be approved?
Answer:

Question: What are the three authorisation clauses a new vendor agrees to when creating a vendor record?
Answer:
Upon creating a new vendor record, the vendor authorises three clauses:

- Clause 1: I/We hereby authorise the Government and Statutory Boards to credit payments due to me/us to the stated account. Amounts so credited would constitute valid discharge of obligations due to me/us. [as shown in the “Authorisation” section of the Create New Vendor flow] [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

- Clause 2: This authorisation shall continue to be in force until I/we have notified you in writing. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

- Clause 3: I/We hereby request and authorise the Government and Statutory Boards to obtain confirmation/verification of information relating to me/us and/or to my/our account(s) from/with the bank where the account is maintained as stated in the form. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

Note: The first page shown (page 4) of the vendor creation document contains the explicit wording of these three authorisation statements. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

Question: What are the system maintenance windows during which vendor details cannot be updated?
Answer:
During routine system maintenance, vendor details cannot be updated between 0500hrs to 0600hrs, and 1900hrs to 1930hrs (GMT+8), from Monday to Saturday. This information is shown on the page titled “Why am I unable to update my vendor details?” [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34]. [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34]
